title: low fire and no smoke
description: make the fire lower and no smoke
body:
**make the fire lower and no smoke**

**low fire and no smoke** is a minimal client-side resource pack that shortens Minecraft’s fire texture into a flat, low profile strip along the top of the block.  
It is designed to keep flames visible while greatly reducing how much they block your view when building, mining, or fighting.

**Features:**

•	Replaces tall vanilla fire with a thin, low fire border around the block edge

•	Makes it easier to see mobs, blocks, and your crosshair behind fire

•	Useful for PvP, nether builds, and general survival without changing hitboxes 
or damage

•	Very lightweight: only edits the fire texture, no performance impact

**License / Permissions:**

•The low fire texture in this pack is my own edit of the vanilla asset.

•Do not re‑upload this pack to other sites.

•You may use it in videos or modpacks; a credit link is appreciated but not required.
